payload.reason: The evidence provides specific information about the performance results of models after addressing class imbalance through oversampling, indicating significant improvements in performance metrics.

claims.text: Oversampling the bullying class improved the performance of all DNN models significantly across evaluation measures.
The smallest dataset, Formspring, showed particularly notable performance improvements due to oversampling.
Oversampled datasets (F+, T+, W+) outperformed their non-oversampled counterparts (F, T, W).
